policy.derivation_note: NSFDC publishes ONE indicative activity taxonomy (S004) covering its credit schemes. The corpus does NOT state per-activity or per-scheme eligibility. Sector/activity membership is therefore mapped to the four income-generating schemes (MFS, TL, AMY, UNY) as UNVERIFIED, inherit-from-sector relationships. This is an ASSUMPTION, not a verified fact.
policy.verification_note: Per-activity verification is a follow-on task (M2/Gemini + scheme documents). Until then, the Intelligence Engine must present activity-based eligibility as provisional and UNVERIFIED (PRD 40/25/20/15: Activity Match weight must not silently turn into a hard eligibility claim).
